themes.name: Agentic AI
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can perform tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, often in research, development, or operational contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content about AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, or debugging code, including code generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing AI-powered platforms and tools designed to accelerate or enhance various stages of the research process, from discovery to analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the study of AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, biases, and impact on user interaction and information seeking.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms and systems built to facilitate AI research, development, or the deployment of AI models and agents.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is changing the job market, including job displacement, skill requirements, and the future of work.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Content related to AI's application in the design process, including UX/UI design, generative design, and design system development.

themes.name: AI tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that evaluate, compare, and rank different AI tools based on features, performance, or specific use cases.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Discussions on using AI for analyzing qualitative and quantitative data, identifying themes, and extracting insights from research.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content related to using AI for testing products and interfaces, including automated testing and performance evaluation.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
